newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish unions, government fail to agree on pay rise.
newsitem.headline: Polish unions, government fail to agree on pay rise.

text.p: Poland's Trilateral Commission, grouping representatives of the government, trade unions and employers, failed to agree over pay rises for the enterprise sector next year, PAP news agency reported on Monday.
The government proposed to increase wages in state-owned enterprises by 16 percent in 1997, but unions wanted 18 percent.
As a result, the unions set up a sub-committee to work out by next Friday an offer acceptable to all sides, PAP said.
If negotiations on next year's wage rises are not concluded by the end of the month, the government will make the decision on its own. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
